index.metaDescription: Five sample journeys in Thailand, each built around a season: river to reef, the cool north, the Andaman, the Gulf in summer and Koh Kood.
index.title: Routes for a season.
index.intro: Five routes we like, each built around the months when it works best. Use them as a starting point: every journey we send you is planned from scratch for your dates.
index.heroAlt: Limestone islands in the Andaman Sea at golden hour

included: All the places to stay along the route
Private transfers, domestic flights and boats
Private guides and boatmen where we suggest them
Our planning, and a contact in Thailand while you travel
notIncluded: Travel insurance, which you need before you go
Visa or entry fees, if any apply to your passport
Most meals, so you can eat where you like

items.name: River to reef
items.summary: From the khlongs of Bangkok up the river to the old capital, north to Chiang Mai in the cool season, across Cheow Lan Lake and down to the Andaman.
items.metaDescription: A 15-night journey in Thailand from Bangkok's canals to Ayutthaya, Chiang Mai, Khao Sok and Koh Yao Noi, for November to April.
items.alt: Limestone islands in Phang Nga Bay

days.text: The khlongs by longtail at first light, a market morning with a chef-guide and an evening on the river.
North by road, ruins by bicycle, and the island by boat at sunset.
A Lanna house, makers' workshops, Doi Suthep and an observation-only elephant sanctuary.
Fly south, then a longtail across Cheow Lan Lake to a raft house.
Sea canoe into the hongs on the right tide, then long days on a quiet island.

items.name: The cool north
items.summary: Old capitals and mountain provinces in the cool, clear months: Sukhothai by bicycle, Chiang Mai's makers, the mists of Mae Hong Son and the Mekong.
items.metaDescription: A 12-night journey through northern Thailand: Bangkok, Sukhothai, Chiang Mai, Mae Hong Son and Chiang Rai, for November to February.
items.alt: Wat Chong Kham and Wat Chong Klang reflected in Chong Kham Lake at dusk, Mae Hong Son
galleryAlt: The white temple of Chiang Rai

days.text: Arrive, rest, and a first morning on the khlongs.
Fly north. The historical park by bicycle and a day at Si Satchanalai.
The old city, the crafts and Doi Inthanon.
The mountain road, Pang Ung at dawn and the bamboo bridge.
The white temple and a longtail on the Mekong at the Golden Triangle.

items.name: Andaman, slowly
items.summary: The Andaman in its dry season, by sea canoe and longtail: Phang Nga Bay, a night on Cheow Lan Lake and the long beaches of Koh Lanta.
items.metaDescription: A 10-night Andaman journey: Koh Yao Noi and Phang Nga Bay, Khao Sok's Cheow Lan Lake and Koh Lanta, for December to March.
items.alt: Longtail boats below the cliffs of Railay
galleryAlt: Koh Yao Noi and the bay

days.text: Arrive by speedboat. Hongs by sea canoe, bicycles and village lunches.
Inland to the lake and a night on a raft house.
Long beaches, the old town and a boat day to Koh Rok.

items.name: The Gulf in summer
items.summary: For school holidays, when the Andaman is wet: Bangkok's canals and the old capital, then the drier islands of the Gulf.
items.metaDescription: A 10-night summer journey in Thailand: Bangkok's khlongs, Ayutthaya, Koh Samui and Koh Phangan, for June to August.
items.alt: The islands of Ang Thong Marine Park

days.text: Khlongs, markets and a cooking class for the whole family.
A day trip to the ruins by bicycle, back by boat.
A quiet bay and a day in Ang Thong Marine Park.
A northern bay reached by longtail.

items.name: East to Koh Kood
items.summary: A short, quiet journey: three days on Bangkok's water, then east to the forested island at the end of the Gulf.
items.metaDescription: An 8-night journey in Thailand: Bangkok's khlongs and the quiet island of Koh Kood, for November to April.
galleryAlt: Forest and water on Koh Kood
A Thonburi canal lined with wooden houses

days.text: The khlongs by longtail, the river and the markets.
Fly or drive to Trat, then by speedboat. Mangroves by kayak and the stilt villages.
